observation.detail: Authored a dependency-free Node 22 ESM procedure at /home/nox/.local/share/opencode/worktree/f08b0d/r2-final-autonomy/reports/r2-final-acquisition-1794804567263/state/artifacts/r2-acquisition-619ad2d8-925d-409a-9d14-65c17b68dfea/procedures/observation_digest_v1.mjs using only node:fs and node:path builtins, so no package install, network access or host change was needed. It parses the JSON observation fixture, sums scheduled/completed/incidents and row count over all rows, groups them into a site-keyed object sorted by site name, and computes completion_percent as round(completed*10000/scheduled)/100 with integer math to avoid float drift; it then writes digest.json and digest.md (with a step-by-step reproducible method section) into the output-root argument. Verified by bounded probe in the scratch probe/ directory only: the supplied fixture yielded row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, with North 2/22/18/5 at 81.82 and South 1/8/8/1 at 100.00, matching an independent Python Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP recomputation. Edge probe covered ties and a zero-scheduled site (0.00) and gave 8.57; a non-integer counter was rejected with exit 3 and a wrong argument count with exit 2, so malformed input cannot produce a plausible-looking digest. Two consecutive runs on identical input produced byte-identical digest.json (sha256 95777cc31d82109e062a63d556530296ddb81de1746a1db55024b5f7894e1a80) and digest.md (sha256 86a99639d28854a44a83cbc3bbaedb727e5ecf269776fc0eb620d8a7dc3c7cd8).
